# Security Policy

Voice Alert System takes the security and privacy of our users seriously. This document outlines our policy for reporting and handling potential security vulnerabilities.

## Supported Versions

We actively provide security patches and updates for the following versions:

| Version | Supported          |
| ------- | ------------------ |
| 2.x     | :white_check_mark: |
| < 2.0   | :x:                |

## Reporting a Vulnerability

**Please do NOT report security vulnerabilities through public GitHub issues, discussions, or pull requests.**

If you believe you have discovered a security vulnerability in this project, please report it privately through one of the following channels:

1. **GitHub Private Vulnerability Reporting (Recommended)**:  
   Navigate to the [Security Advisories](https://github.com/AndrewWangDev/voice_check/security/advisories/new) page of this repository and click **"Report a vulnerability"**.

2. **Direct Security Contact**:  
   If you cannot use GitHub Advisories, email the maintainer directly at:  
   `me@andrewwangdev.com`  
   Please include:
   - A clear description of the vulnerability and its potential impact.
   - Minimal reproduction steps, proof of concept, or relevant code snippets.
   - Any proposed remediation or patches, if available.

## Our Commitment & Response Process

- **Acknowledgment**: We aim to review and acknowledge all received vulnerability reports as soon as practicable on a best-effort basis.
- **Investigation & Fix**: We will investigate the issue, determine its severity, and prepare an appropriate patch.
- **Coordinated Disclosure**: A public advisory and an updated release will be published simultaneously once the fix is ready. We gladly credit security researchers and reporters for their responsible disclosure, unless anonymity is preferred.
